decisions.reason: LLM choice API supports required ticker parameter to fetch 24-hour ticker data for specific stocks, matching the step better than semantic top-1 which is unrelated to these stocks.
Semantic top-1 API is the same as LLM choice and is appropriate; no change needed.
LLM choice API explicitly provides opening and closing prices for specified stock symbols, better matching the step than semantic top-1 which is options data only.
LLM choice API provides historical prices but does not perform calculation; semantic top-1 is unrelated to calculation; neither directly matches calculation step, so keep semantic top-1.
